A nested table flattened into a cell keeps its row boundaries as literal <br> when br_in_tables is enabled

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ConversionOptions, convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const options: ConversionOptions = { brInTables: true, compactTables: true };
  const result = convert("<table><tr><td><p>Before</p><table><tr><th>ID</th><th>Status</th></tr><tr><td>123</td><td>Done</td></tr></table></td><td>Other</td></tr></table>", options);
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
